Required Skills & Experience  
  
6+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience operating independently in an enterprise environment.  
Advanced, hands-on SQL skills, including querying and manipulating large datasets, working across multiple tables, joins, data validation, and troubleshooting data issues independently.  
Strong Python skills for data analysis, modeling, transformation, and automation.  
Experience working with complex, high-volume datasets within GCP or a comparable cloud data environment.  
Exceptional verbal communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical approaches, individual contributions, business impact, and recommendations.  
Strong business acumen with the ability to understand the business strategy behind an analytics request and connect technical work to broader organizational objectives.  
Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior business and executive stakeholders.  
Proven ability to independently own analytics initiatives with limited day-to-day technical guidance while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.  
  
Nice to Have Skills & Experience  
  
Experience with marketing analytics, attribution modeling, customer segmentation, buyer group modeling, or ideal customer profile development.  
Experience applying AI and machine learning techniques within analytics, modeling, or data science workflows.  
Familiarity with modern generative AI tools and their application to analytics or productivity workflows.  
Exposure to Teradata, PySpark, Scala, or similar big data technologies.  
Telecommunications industry experience.  
  
Job Description  
  
As a Data Scientist on this team, you will support a marketing analytics organization by using data to influence strategic business decisions and improve marketing performance.  
  
You will work across initiatives including marketing attribution, customer segmentation, buyer group modeling, and ideal customer profile development. This includes querying and transforming large datasets, developing analytical models, identifying trends and insights, and translating findings into clear business recommendations.  
  
This role requires someone who can independently work through data problems from initial question through analysis and recommendation, while understanding how their work connects to broader business objectives. You will partner closely with technical and business stakeholders and may present findings and recommendations to senior and executive-level audiences.  
  
Success in this role requires a combination of strong hands-on SQL and Python capability, analytical thinking, business acumen, independence, and exceptional communication skills.

## **Intro**

Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off? Join our American Airlines family, and you’ll travel the world, grow your expertise and become the best version of you.  As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life.  Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop on board!

## **Why you'll love this job**

This job is a member of the Operations Research and Advanced Analytics (OR&AA) team. Positioned within the Information Technology organization, the OR&AA team at American Airlines has a long history of being on the leading edge of analytics in the airline domain. Nearly four decades ago we launched the revenue management revolution with our yield management strategy. Today our diverse team of passionate analytics professionals supports decision making across the airline, including pricing and revenue management, fleet and network optimization, crew and flight scheduling, airport and maintenance operations and customer/social media analytics. We are constantly on the lookout to bring together exciting technologies, like the latest in cloud technology, with cutting-edge analytical methods, such as deep learning, computer vision, and natural language processing, to create a competitive edge for American.

## **What you'll do**

*As noted above, this list is intended to reflect the current job but there may be additional essential functions (and certainly non-essential job functions) that are not referenced.  Management will modify the job or require other tasks be performed whenever it is deemed appropriate to do so, observing, of course, any legal obligations including any collective bargaining obligations.*

* Collaborative problem-solving: partner with cross-functional teams and other analytics professionals to identify high-impact business opportunities and frame analytical problems that align with organizational goals.
* Data acquisition and preparation: obtain, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data from diverse sources to ensure robust data pipelines. Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover insights. 
* Deployment and maintenance: deploy models as proofs of concept and collaborate with IT engineers to integrate models into production environments. Monitor and maintain deployed models to ensure continued effectiveness.
* Data visualization and reporting: create compelling dashboards and reports to communicate findings to stakeholder, translating data insights into actionable business recommendations. 
* Thought leadership and advocacy: promote data-driven decision-making across the organization by leading workshops, developing tutorials, and sharing best practices in data science.

## **All you'll need for success**

**Minimum Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience**

* Master’s/PhD degree or Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of equivalent practical experience
* Experience with at least one programming language
* Practical experience with data extraction, cleaning, and analysis 
* Knowledge of statistical and machine learning techniques

**Preferred Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience**

* Practical experience in designing, building and deploying machine learning models.
* Experience working with cloud environments (e.g., Azure ML, Databricks) and managing production deployments.
* Proficiency in SQL, MongoDB, IMSDB and data visualization (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Prior experience in consulting roles, demonstrating the ability to manage client relationships and deliver data-driven solutions.
* Domain knowledge in the airline industry or related fields is highly desirable.

**Skills, Licenses & Certifications**

* Demonstrated aptitude for logical analysis, problem identification, and problem solving
* Ability to view data from different angles to employ feature engineering techniques to better represent models
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to interact, work, and develop relationships with people from diverse backgrounds

## **What you'll get**

Feel free to take advantage of all that American Airlines has to offer:

* Travel Perks: Ready to explore the world? You, your family and your friends can reach 365 destinations on more than 6,800 daily flights across our global network.
* Health Benefits: On day one, you’ll have access to your health, dental, prescription and vision benefits to help you stay well. And that’s just the start, we also offer virtual doctor visits, flexible spending accounts and more.
* Wellness Programs: We want you to be the best version of yourself – that’s why our wellness programs provide you with all the right tools, resources and support you need.
* 401(k) Program: Available upon hire and, depending on the workgroup, employer contributions to your 401(k) program are available after one year.
* Additional Benefits: Other great benefits include our Employee Assistance Program, pet insurance and discounts on hotels, cars, cruises and more

## **Feel free to be yourself at American**

From the team members we hire to the customers we serve, inclusion and diversity are the foundation of the dynamic workforce at American Airlines. Our 20+ Team Member Business Resource Groups are focused on connecting our team members to our customers, suppliers, communities and shareholders, helping team members reach their full potential and creating an inclusive work environment to meet and exceed the needs of our diverse world.  
  
Are you ready to feel a tremendous sense of pride and satisfaction as you do your part to keep the largest airline in the world running smoothly as we care for people on life’s journey? Feel free to be yourself at American.

You will own the design, validation, documentation, and delivery of the statistical and machine learning / predictive modeling algorithms and analyses that help employers and their partners understand cost, risk, and the impact of health programs – including total-cost-of-care predictive modeling and causal evaluations of programs and vendors using matched cohort trial emulation, difference-in-differences, and risk adjustment. You will work to evolve capabilities and model performance, review code and models, document and present results to clients and senior leaders, and take models from development into governed, monitored production, working closely with actuaries, consultants, clinical and innovation specialists, Aon Business Solutions / Technology (ABS), technology architects, and engineering teams. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of experience including commercial health insurance and/or health benefits consulting, a strong foundation in applied statistics and causal inference, and a track record of building and deploying tabular predictive models on large medical and pharmacy claims datasets. Productization & Go-To-Market

Vitol is a leader in energy and commodities. Vitol produces, manages and delivers energy and commodities to consumers and industry worldwide. In addition to its primary business of trading, Vitol is invested in infrastructure globally, with $10+billion invested in long-term assets.

Vitol’s customers include national oil companies, multinationals, leading industrial companies and utilities. Founded in Rotterdam in 1966, today Vitol serves its customers from more than 40 offices worldwide. Revenues in 2025 were $343bn.

Our people are our business. Talent is precious to us and we create an environment in which individuals can reach their full potential, unhindered by hierarchy. Our team comprises more than 65+ nationalities and we are committed to developing and sustaining a diverse work force.

 [Learn more about us here](https://www.vitol.com/). **This role is located in Houston, TX onsite 5x a week**

## Job Description

Vitol’s Applied ML team in Houston works directly with the trading desks to find commercial value through data and applied data science . Projects start with a trader’s or analyst’s question, not with a model.

You will work alongside traders and analysts from the first conversation through to production and beyond. You frame the problem with them, review results with them as the work progresses, and stay with the tool after it ships.

You own both the science and its path to production. The work is fast and phased, and it is judged on one thing: whether the desk uses it to make better decisions.

**What You Will Do**

* Work side by side with traders and analysts to turn market questions into scoped projects, each with a clear commercial hypothesis and a defined go/no-go point.
* Review progress with the desk throughout each project, not just at handoff. Show intermediate results early, test them against the desk’s market knowledge, and change course when the signal or the priority shifts.
* Build LLM, NLP and multimodal pipelines that extract structured signals from unstructured sources such as outage reports, news, filings, and web content.
* Design and run quick experiments to test feasibility across modelling approaches, and stop weak ideas early.
* Build models that predict outage impacts, classify disruption patterns, and detect anomalies and regime changes in fundamental data.
* Take the models that prove out into production. That means packaged, tested, deployed through CI/CD, with monitoring and drift detection built in from day one.
* Deliver insights where traders already work: Teams, alerts, and the Vision Excel and Python tooling. Standalone dashboards are not the default.
* Source data through the Vision platform. When you need a new source, work with the Vision team rather than building side pipelines, and follow the existing web-scraping architecture.
* Evaluate commercial AI platforms and tools against real desk problems, and give a clear recommendation.
* Explain results, uncertainty, and limits in plain terms to traders, analysts, and senior stakeholders.

## Qualifications

* **Applied experience:** 5+ years applying machine learning and NLP to messy, real-world data, including models you took to production and supported after launch.
* **Desk-facing track record:** You have worked directly with commercial users in trading, finance, or a similar fast-paced setting, and you can point to decisions your work changed.
* **Quantitative foundation:** Master’s or PhD in statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, or equivalent depth gained in industry. Strong statistics and experimental design.
* **LLMs and NLP:** Hands-on experience building extraction and classification pipelines with LLMs, covering evaluation, prompt and retrieval design, and cost and latency trade-offs.
* **Python and ML stack:** Python with scikit-learn, PyTorch, and HuggingFace. You write production-quality code that others can review and maintain.
* **Production engineering:** Docker, AWS, CI/CD, and MLOps practice, including model versioning, monitoring, and retraining.
* **Time series and signals:** Experience with anomaly detection and with combining signals across multiple time-series and text sources.
* **Communication:** You can explain what a model means for a trade in two sentences, and you are comfortable being challenged by people who know the market better than you do.
* **Nice to have:** Knowledge of energy or commodities markets, graph modelling, sentiment analysis, or agentic workflows and MCP.

## Additional Information

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* Traders and analysts on at least two desks bring problems to you directly.
* At least two proof-of-value projects reach a go/no-go decision, and at least one is in production and in regular use on the desk.
* Your production models are monitored, documented, and supportable by the wider team. Failures are found by monitoring, not by a trader.
* Failed experiments are stopped early and written up, so the team does not repeat them.
* You have built reusable components, such as extraction pipelines and evaluation harnesses, that the rest of the team uses.

**The Environment**

Vitol is one of the world’s largest independent energy traders, and Houston is one of its core trading offices. The Applied ML team sits close to the desks, so feedback is fast and the people using your work are just a few desks away.

We look for scientists and engineers who own outcomes, not just tickets. You will have room to choose your approach, and you will be expected to deliver work that traders can rely on.

**Comprehensive benefit coverage includes:**

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Paid Vacation
* 401k with company contributions
* Life insurance
* Short-term & Long-term disability

*All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*
